Chapter 6960: Lowered Head

Chapter 6960: Lowered Head

“It’s fine, I can go myself.” Li Qiye smiled and shook his head.

“Be careful then.” Tribulation Daoist said before leaving.

***

Li Qiye’s destination was the largest city in this world - Myriad Buddhas City. Its prosperity was due to its proximity to Myriad Buddhas Monastery.

People came and went between streets filled with pavilions and buildings. It came into prominence at the same time as Myriad Buddhas Monastery.

The sect itself was built on a mountain range behind the city. The buildings seen beyond the fog and mist painted an ethereal scene.

Laypeople in the city aspired to join the sect. Of course, some fulfilled this goal through dedication and hard work.

Aside from the monastery, this region was also home to the Myriad Tribulations Sect and its talisman-focused members.

In the city, a transcending aura could be sensed due to the Buddhist path. The laypeople and mortals here were simpler with fewer desires.

Interestingly enough, it produced several emperors and ancient ancestors in a single era. This was virtually unheard of in the nine worlds.

He thought this world was a miracle and appreciated its simplicity and unhurried nature. Outside by the gate was Mundane Immortal’s statue. This one towered compared to those in the villages, visible from afar.

The city inhabitants carved it themselves out of respect, not members of the monastery. It resembled the others, depicting her placing her palms together while bowing her head.

“Mundane Immortal.” Li Qiye smiled and read the inscription on an introduction tablet placed before the statue.

“Walk the dao path with lowered head.” Li Qiye was happy to read it.

“Do you understand the meaning?” Tribulation Daoist suddenly appeared next to him.

“No.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“This is her dao and also her best technique.” He elaborated: “Young man, you are quite fast, it wasn’t a short distance.”

He changed Li Qiye from “child” to “young man” while staring intensely at him.

“Just have to walk, and I’ll arrive.” Li Qiye said.

“Would have to walk quite fast.” He wondered how a mortal could be so fast.

“I’m just fast on my feet.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Where are you from, young man?” He was suspicious despite seeing Li Qiye’s mortal state.

“I don’t know, I’ve been to many places.” Li Qiye said.

“So you’re not from Myriad Buddhas Monastery.” He said.

“No, just here to take a look after hearing about it.” Li Qiye answered.

“Not from our Myriad Tribulations Sect either.” He said: “Are you from Survivor Realm?”

“Survivor Realm?” Li Qiye asked.

“Where we are standing is Survivor Realm, or Tribulation’s End.” He explained, suspecting that Li Qiye was not from here.

Initially, this world was also engulfed in tribulations. It took many eras to quell the chaos and dangers.

It wouldn’t make sense for Li Qiye to be from the outside world either. How could a mortal bypass the tribulation oceans?

“Just a mortal from the mortal realm.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Can’t be if you’re not from here.” He didn’t like the answer.

“Then what am I?” Li Qiye patiently responded.
